summary: Ibex SG13G2/EZ130 RTL-to-GDS on a 4-vCPU cloud host: RustEDA native flow against LibreLane 3.0.17 with the same prepared inputs and the same independent gate scripts, plus module head-to-heads.

design.rtl_note: sv2v 0.0.13.1 output; the 2026-10-30 campaign's file was 8a8fe84b… (different sv2v build)

technology.standard_cell_library: EZ130 8T v1.1 (tech LEF and GDS reconstructed; see ez130_files)
technology.ez130_summary: 5 of 7 contract-pinned EZ130 files byte-identical; SG13G2 tech LEF and GDS reconstructed; the catalog-pinned FF Liberty is also byte-identical

host.cgroup: v1 memory controller; each timed stage alone in its own child group
host.allocation: all 4 vCPUs to each flow; RustEDA 8 GiB cap (+2 GiB memsw), LibreLane 10 GiB cap; no swap device
host.sampling: one timed sample per flow; module stages one warm-up plus three measured repetitions
host.facts_source: captured on the campaign host by make_receipt.py at commit 752f68e (2026-11-02); corroborated by the RustSpice suite run-time host record

RustEDA.configuration: published repository recipe (run16-class), composed by compose_native.py; grouped single-process antenna session; RustROAD route, post-route and antenna repair at --threads 4, frontend placement/CTS at --threads 2, extract, export-gds and other export/inspect steps on the default 2-thread pool; unqualified
RustEDA.end_to_end_scope: sv2v preparation + producer (synthesis through extraction, OpenRCX and RustSTA/OpenSTA signoff timing) + shared gates the producer did not reach (foundry main and antenna DRC, LVS, vendor simulation, synthesis/final equivalence, density)

determinism.note: artifact identity across two complete native runs; the OpenRCX SPEF is written by OpenROAD

LibreLane.configuration: LibreLane 3.0.17 Classic flow through Checker.XOR, prepared contract config, DRT_THREADS=4, RUN_POST_GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR=true (LibreLane's own post-GRT repair instead of the historical RustEDA-authored DRV ECO loop)

LibreLane.equivalence_checker_note: obligation export: 433 implementation states lack a unique named RTL counterpart; first _21851_ (DFFRQX1)
LibreLane.end_to_end_scope: sv2v preparation + LibreLane flow through Checker.XOR + every shared gate (foundry main and antenna DRC, OpenRCX, RustSTA/OpenSTA timing, LVS, vendor simulation, equivalence, density)

librelane_prepared_config.configuration: LibreLane 3.0.17 Classic, prepared contract config unchanged (RUN_POST_GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR=false), DRT_THREADS=4; bring-up run under shared host load, so its times are not benchmark measurements

synthesis.task: prepared Ibex RTL (sv2v) to EZ130 TT + SRAM Liberty mapped netlist

extraction.thread_note: RustROAD sizes its thread pool from --threads (default 2); the recorded extract and export-gds commands pass none, so every RustROAD run used a 2-thread pool and the _t4 rows are a second 2-thread sample. RAYON_NUM_THREADS does not size it. OpenRCX used set_thread_count 2 and 4.

timing.scope: RustSTA: init+import+run (TT and SS in one run)+8 reports; OpenSTA: one process per corner (read, link, SDC, SPEF, full reports)

gds.note: rerun after giving KLayout a .def path; the first replay failed before reading the DEF
gds.thread_note: RustROAD export-gds ran on its default 2-thread pool; KLayout's LEF/DEF reader is single-process.

ratios.eligibility: not eligible: a flow failed or left a gate unverified; see gates

deviations: EZ130 SG13G2 tech LEF and cell GDS reconstructed from public sources (not byte-identical to the pinned archive)
nixpkgs tool builds (OpenROAD 26Q3, Yosys 0.70) instead of LibreLane's pinned OpenROAD dcf36133 / Yosys 0.62
native recipe composed without component-qualification evidence: eight derived qualification gates not produced
native recipe is the repository's run16-class recipe; the R20/R21 recipe inputs are not published
host-local helper patches: thread allow-lists (4), cgroup-v1 ownership, RC-profile rules path, density DEF parser
LibreLane without the historical RustEDA-authored repair loop; its own post-GRT design repair enabled
4 vCPUs (Xeon 2.1 GHz) instead of 16 logical CPUs of an i9-13900HX
publication_rule: Only complete independently checked runs with frozen matching inputs may populate end-to-end comparative ratios. Module head-to-heads report each contender's measured time on the identical task. Failed runs are preserved and reported; missing values stay null.
